doc.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023

title: Minor keys and the 2-5-1; goodbyes
summary: Minor keys are fun to play; Frishberg's 2-5 comment; thanks and a first goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Are you tending more toward minor keys?

Yes. Yes absolutely. But primarily because they’re fun to play. You know minor keys, it’s the whole 2-5-1 thing, right? You know why go 5 major to 1 major when you can go to 2 minor to 5? I mean it’s that 2 minor that’s more fun than anything.
You know what? You know who said that?
Yes he did and he said, I had it here somewhere. He was talking about the 2-5 is the secret of the universe or something like that.

Yeah, yeah I get it. Because you know if you hang out in that harmonic space it’s like everything’s a kind of roller coaster. It’s fun. You’re always on the way there, you never have to get there. You’re always in the process, it’s great.
When are we going to get there? Not soon.
Not soon. Hopefully not too soon, yeah. Hey thanks Monk, it’s been a pleasure, really.
